title: Removal of officers.
bodyText: Section 421-16, relating to the removal of an officer of an agricultural association, shall apply to associations formed under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§421C-18]  Removal of officers.  Section 421-16, relating to the removal of an officer of an agricultural association, shall apply to associations formed under this chapter. [L 1982, c 97, pt of §2]
